title: Same Facts, Different Decision: Fact-Invariant Manipulation and Provenance-Based Defense in Typed Decision Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.27016v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Typed decision models such as TypeSafe's Jev answer only with a probability, an option, or a score, so software can act on them directly. Their inputs, however, often include text from outsiders. Prior attacks test this risk poorly. Injected instructions rarely work on these models, and added facts can make a changed decision correct. We show that outside comments can persuade these models to make a wrong decision without adding any fact. We propose LEVER, an attack that writes such comments with four levers from argumentation theory, uses a separate verifier to discard any comment that adds a fact, and searches for effective comments guided by the model's output probabilities. We further propose the Provenance Gate, a defense that accepts a changed decision only if the model reaches it again without the outside comments. translated_title: 相同事实，不同决策：类型化决策模型中的事实不变性操纵与基于来源的防御
translated_abstract: 诸如TypeSafe的Jev等类型化决策模型仅以概率、选项或分数的形式给出答案，因此软件可以直接根据其输出采取行动。然而，这些模型的输入通常包含来自外部人员的文本。以往的攻击对此风险的测试效果不佳：注入的指令在这些模型上很少奏效，而添加的事实可能使被改变的决策变得正确。我们证明，外部评论可以在不添加任何事实的情况下说服这些模型做出错误决策。我们提出LEVER攻击，该方法利用论证理论中的四个“杠杆”来撰写此类评论，使用独立的验证器丢弃任何添加事实的评论，并以模型的输出概率为引导搜索有效评论。我们进一步提出Provenance Gate防御机制，只有当模型在没有外部评论的情况下再次得出相同决策时，才接受改变后的决策。在三个基准测试中，LEVER翻转了Jev约三分之一的正确决策，是最强先前攻击的2.8倍。
tldr: 论文提出LEVER攻击，利用论证理论中的四个杠杆在不添加任何新事实的情况下操纵类型化决策模型做出错误决策，并提出Provenance Gate防御机制，仅当模型在无外部评论时能复现该决策才予以接受。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes LEVER, an attack that manipulates typed decision models into wrong decisions without adding any facts using four levers from argumentation theory, along with Provenance Gate, a defense that accepts a changed decision only if the model reproduces it without the outside comments.
